_about: Mascot fact boxes (job, home, personality, health quirk), shown on /mascots/<name>/ pages. Keyed by mascot name. "secret" is the line shown when someone taps the mascot ten times (assets/shell.js secrets).

Pebble.health: Seasick on boats, which is embarrassing for a penguin
Pebble.secret: Has a secret pebble collection sorted by evidence level.

Dex.from: A village library in the English countryside
Dex.secret: Once solved a case from the smell of a waiting room.

Vira.from: A Petri dish someone forgot to cover
Vira.secret: Is technically washing her hands of all of this.

Octavia.secret: Can hold eight cups of tea and still judge your groupings.

Bea.from: A hive on a lavender farm
Bea.secret: Has never once been late for handover. Never.

Cadi.health: Dry, flaky skin every shedding season
Cadi.secret: Is wildly jealous of the caduceus. One snake? Amateurs.

Tess.from: The Galápagos, via a country hospital
Tess.secret: Remembers when crosswords were carved into stone.

Silk.from: The corner of an operating theatre
Silk.secret: Sutures in her sleep. Literally. Check the blanket.

Echo.from: Central Africa, via a university lecture theatre
Echo.secret: Repeats every fact twice, just to be sure. Just to be sure.

Ziggy.secret: Gets mistaken for a horse daily. Takes it personally.

Cipher.from: Unknown (she came in through a window)
Cipher.secret: Knows what the clue means. Will not be telling you.

Locum.secret: Hasn’t seen daylight since 2019. Prefers it that way.

Ruby.from: She claims Transylvania; it was actually the pathology lab, level 2
Ruby.secret: Does not drink blood. Only checks it. Mostly.

Riff.health: Occasional ectopic beats, which drive her mad
Riff.secret: Skips a beat whenever someone says ‘sinus rhythm’.

Iris.from: A barn, then the night endocrine lab
Iris.secret: Keeps a spare thyroid joke for every occasion.

Mira.from: Madagascar, via a skin-clinic pot plant
Mira.health: Eczema that flares when she's stressed
Mira.secret: Changes colour when you call everything eczema.

Lumo.from: The ocean, via a storm drain into radiology
Lumo.health: Burns in about four minutes of sun
Lumo.secret: Glows a little brighter when the report says ‘incidental’.

Digby.from: North America, behind a school for deaf children
Digby.secret: Has dug up three femurs. All plastic. Probably.

Lottie.from: Lake Xochimilco in Mexico, via an anatomy school's jar room
Lottie.health: None. She regrows everything, and she's smug about it
Lottie.secret: Grows back anything. Except her patience for typos.

Sunny.secret: Calculates the sensitivity of every compliment.

Brix.health: Bad back, refuses to see a physio
Brix.secret: Built a burrow with perfect corners. Measured it twice.

Kiri.secret: Has 300 teeth and flosses every single one.

Zola.secret: Her headlamp has a backup headlamp.

Tembi.health: Very high blood pressure, which is normal for a giraffe
Tembi.secret: Can see your vaccine card from across the clinic.

Magnus.health: High cholesterol, caught early and managed
Magnus.secret: Booked his own check-up. Told nobody. Felt great.

Otto.secret: Will sit with you as long as you need. No talking required.

Fig.secret: Once confiscated a detox tea at a party. No regrets.

Marisol.secret: Knows every lullaby in eleven languages.

Quill.health: Hoarse voice after a big impression
Quill.secret: Can do a perfect impression of your phone’s ringtone.

Yara.from: Iceland, technically; she lives on the wing
Yara.secret: Has flown further than most airlines. Still gets jet lag.

Yuki.health: Dry eyes from reading fine print
Yuki.secret: Reads the leaflet inside the box. For fun.

Norm.secret: Has never once been in a hurry. Thriving.

Inês.secret: Has never raised her voice. The silence is worse.

Saga.secret: Has 47 browser tabs open and knows what every one is.

Percy.health: A sore shoulder from carrying too much
Percy.secret: Carries a spare referral letter in his beak at all times.

Mei.from: An escapee from a research facility
Mei.secret: Asks for the methods section before saying hello.

Ama.from: The roof of a health-food shop
Ama.secret: Has a nest full of busted myths. Shinier than gold.

Nalu.secret: Sees both sides of every argument. Literally.

Hana.health: Peanut allergy, always carries her adrenaline autoinjector
Hana.secret: Only puffs up for a very good reason.

Jett.health: Achilles tendinopathy, doing her own rehab
Jett.secret: Hops 10,000 steps before breakfast. Annoying, honestly.

Kip.health: Snores, so now uses a CPAP machine

Layla.health: Long-term fatigue, paces like a pro
Layla.secret: Took three days to tell you this. Worth it.

Hazel.secret: Has never broken a streak. Do not ask her about Leap Day.

Pippa.health: Sore feet from long days on the floor
Pippa.secret: Remembers the name of every patient. And their dog.

Hugo.from: A mountain gym in the Canadian Rockies
Hugo.secret: Cries at every plaster cast signing. Every single one.

Esme.from: A desert burrow in East Africa
Esme.secret: Can tell what you had for lunch by smell alone. Please don’t test her.

Noor.from: A busy family home in Amman
Noor.secret: Her name sign is a paw tapping her spotty cheek.
